Meet Mochi, your new focus companion! 🍡 Mochi Focus is a Pomodoro timer with a twist—your adorable mascot evolves as you stay focused. Start with a tiny Baby Mochi and watch it grow into Mega Mochi as you level up. ✨ Key features: • Customizable timer (1-120 min) • XP & leveling system (50 levels) • 4 evolution stages • Website blocker during focus • Daily streaks & achievements • Beautiful themes to unlock Grow soft, focus strong.
